title: 227쪽 · floating to Check-Raise
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: no tip: I's okay to float out of position if you have equity and a wellthought-out plan,
$5-$10NL: The Button raises to $30. Hero calls.

Check-calling with two overcards and a backdoor flush draw can be a profitable play against late position openers who c-bet too much. Your goal is to make a pair that Villain thinks he can represent. You can also stab the river if Villain checks the turn, check-raise the turn if you pickup a draw or check-raise the river to represent a flush.
Hero checks. Villain bets $30. Hero calls,
him to check-fold the flop. 24 of the 47 unseen turn cards help his cause
